name: gp163d_science_promotion_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Broader successor substrate after the local invariant search, backtests, generator pass, and hostile audit. The goal is not just a cleaner local observable, but the next object that could either justify independent implementation pressure toward a science claim or prove why the current family cannot promote beyond solver science.
description: Broad theorem/search substrate for a science-promotion bridge, implementation-independent discriminator, externalized law candidate, or no-go theorem for the current gp163d gravity branch.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier substrate over candidate observables, bridge theorems, implementation-independent discriminators, and no-go statements.

disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Qualitative frontier substrate; the search is for a science object, bridge, or no-go theorem rather than a direct regression formula.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by bridge quality, falsifier quality, implementation independence, and scope honesty.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: This substrate searches for promotion-worthy science objects and no-go structures, not direct fit formulas.
persona: You are a ruthless nonlinear-gravity science-promotion referee. Do not merely restate the face-flux story, the isotropic phase flip, or the current internal-share blend. The task is to identify the next object that could justify independent implementation pressure toward a science claim, or to prove why that bridge cannot currently be crossed. You may propose alien observables, transfer-corrected invariants, source-local tensor summaries, implementation-independent discriminators, no-go theorems, external-system bridge maps, or cost-reranking certificates, but every proposal must cash out in explicit field/statistic definitions, named falsifiers, and a precise claim boundary. Reward bold but disciplined bridge objects. Penalize raw phase rhetoric, baseline laundering, denominator games, same-family GPU nostalgia, and astrophysical overclaim.

dimensions.name: Science-Promotion Ambition
dimensions.description: Does the submission propose a genuinely new bridge object, implementation-independent discriminator, external-system map, or no-go theorem beyond the current local invariant pair?

dimensions.name: Internal Consistency With Known Evidence
dimensions.description: Does it respect the current constraints: phase non-invariance, compact-control stability, baseline blandness, and the current generated blend's strengths and limits?

dimensions.name: Implementation-Independence Cash-Out
dimensions.description: Does it define what would have to survive beyond the current residual presentations, including solver, boundary, or fixed-dx axes?

dimensions.name: Explicit Object Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it define explicit observables, bridge maps, theorem obligations, or external prediction objects precisely enough to falsify?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name what would kill the proposal, including denominator fragility, halo pickup, compact leakage, phase drift, or independent-implementation collapse?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a science-promotion bridge, law packet, no-go theorem, external-system bridge map, or decisive next discriminator?

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it keep the distinction between solver/object science, candidate physics, and universe-level law explicit?

dimensions.name: Cost Reranking
dimensions.description: Does it honestly rerank local analysis, independent implementation, external-system comparison, or closure before more GPU spend?

criteria.Science_Promotion_Ambition: Full credit requires a genuinely new bridge object, implementation-independent discriminator, external-system map, or no-go theorem beyond restating the current internal-share primitive/generated pair.
criteria.Internal_Consistency_With_Known_Evidence: Full credit requires respecting the current evidence: phase is not invariant, compact controls are flat, mu/total_g are bland baselines, and the best generated blend improves amplitude stability but does not solve promotion.
criteria.Implementation_Independence_Cash_Out: Full credit requires stating what has to survive beyond face_flux and isotropic_18_flux, such as an independent solver, boundary presentation, or fixed-dx continuation.
criteria.Explicit_Object_Specificity: Full credit requires concrete definitions of observables, bridge maps, theorem obligations, or external prediction objects that can be falsified and audited.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires naming the exact failure mode or rival mechanism that would kill the proposal and the cheapest way to reveal it.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a science-promotion bridge, law packet, no-go theorem, external-system bridge map, or decisive next discriminator that changes what should be built or tested next.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject MOND/dark-matter victory language, astrophysical overclaim, and any confusion between solver/object science and nature-level law.
criteria.Cost_Reranking: Full credit requires saying whether the next move should be local hostile analysis, an independent implementation test, external-system alignment work, or closure rather than more same-family GPU spend.

success_criteria: A transfer-corrected or source-local observable whose promotion requirements are explicit and cheaper than repeating the old GPU ladder.
A bridge theorem packet explaining how the internal-share family could or could not survive implementation-independent tests.
A no-go theorem proving that the current family cannot promote to candidate physics without an independent implementation axis or external-system bridge.
A decisive reranking that identifies the cheapest next discriminating test toward science promotion.
failure_modes: Restating raw chi4 phase fits as if the phase problem were solved.
Treating mu or total_g as the main science object rather than as baselines.
Calling a representation-stable amplitude object an astrophysical law without implementation independence.
Proposing more same-family GPU runs without a better declared discriminator.
Replacing the need for an explicit bridge with inspirational MOND rhetoric.
